text.interpretation: Matched captions and sampling settings. Caption-wise intervals are not training-seed uncertainty. Better CLIP alignment does not establish counting, anatomy or perceptual quality.
text.visual_review: Buses and fruit are clearer; dog anatomy and cyclist/car geometry remain badly distorted.

cifar.scope: Schedules/clipping selected independently on a different reference subset; historical CIFAR test use during development is disclosed.
cifar.interpretation: One-call CD improves modestly; two-call CD worsens and four-call CD remains weak. iCT benefits from refinement but trails the best one-call CD model.
